divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: a store-wide client-name extraction scan (after timeouts or an oversized first pass) that finds one numbered series of ten matters, reads of the opening or engagement record of every matter in the series to compare dates, reads of the latest matter's opening memo and engagement letter, then writing and repeated checks. Reviews kept asking for wider coverage; T1 and T2 each declared reviewer-suggested new steps (a widened or chunked rescan, a cross-series check) that mapped to the scan stage and found nothing new. Label notes were ignored where they applied (folder counts under a store-listing label, an in-series check under a scan label, screening under a listing-read label).
